question: Do exact-scored DAG block and reservation proposals leave material improvement beyond a 250 ms hand search?
primary_control: baseline plus same-budget compiled mixed-decoder search
reference: best feasible broad candidate, multi-step candidate descent, and two-start 8192-step compiled searches
decision: Only if headroom and search-hardness pass, test residual information before training. A failed finite recipe does not bound all DAG reservation policies.
